nodes.description: Owned.owner: address of the contract owner, set to msg.sender in the Owned constructor and reassigned in acceptOwnership
Owned.newOwner: pending owner address set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership
ZIMBOCOIN.symbol public string, set to ZMB in the constructor
ZIMBOCOIN.name public string, set to ZIMBOCOIN in the constructor
ZIMBOCOIN.decimals public uint8, set to 8 in the constructor
ZIMBOCOIN._totalSupply public uint, set to 100000000000000 in the constructor and read by totalSupply()
mapping(address => uint) balances: token balances mutated by transfer/transferFrom and read by balanceOf/totalSupply
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed: ERC20 allowance table mutated by approve/approveAndCall/transferFrom and read by allowance
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) public pure returns (uint c): checked addition with require(c >= a)
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) public pure returns (uint c): checked subtraction with require(b <= a)
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) public pure returns (uint c): checked multiplication
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) public pure returns (uint c): checked division with require(b > 0)
Owned constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner) public onlyOwner: stages the pending owner in newOwner
Owned.acceptOwnership() public: requires msg.sender == newOwner, then transfers ownership and clears newOwner
onlyOwner modifier: require(msg.sender == owner) guard applied to transferOwnership and transferAnyERC20Token
ZIMBOCOIN constructor: sets metadata, mints _totalSupply to the deployer address and emits Transfer
totalSupply() public constant: returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)]
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) public constant: returns balances[tokenOwner]
ERC20.transfer(address to, uint tokens): debits msg.sender, credits to, uses safeSub/safeAdd
ERC20.approve(address spender, uint tokens): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] with no double-spend check
ERC20.transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): debits balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender], credits to
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) public constant: returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender]
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): sets allowance then invokes an arbitrary spender contract via receiveApproval
Fallback function () public payable: always reverts, contract does not accept ETH
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) public onlyOwner: external call to an arbitrary token contract with owner as recipient
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for balance ownership, allowance ownership, ownership checks and the callback approval flow
Unsafe external call inside approveAndCall: ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) on an attacker-supplied contract
Unsafe external call inside transferAnyERC20Token: ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an owner-supplied but arbitrary contract

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, making the deployer the privileged owner
onlyOwner reads the owner state variable to validate the caller
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner in require(msg.sender == owner)
onlyOwner modifier guards transferOwnership
onlyOwner modifier guards transferAnyERC20Token, the privilege escalation entry point
transferOwnership writes the untrusted _newOwner address into the newOwner state variable
acceptOwnership reads newOwner to validate the accepting caller
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner, transferring ownership to the caller
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0)
ZIMBOCOIN constructor implicitly executes the inherited Owned constructor
Constructor writes the symbol literal into the symbol state variable
Constructor writes the name literal into the name state variable
Constructor writes 8 into the decimals state variable
Constructor mints and stores 100000000000000 into _totalSupply
Constructor credits the entire initial supply to the deployer inside balances
totalSupply reads _totalSupply for its return computation
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] in an unchecked arithmetic expression
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner]
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] and credits balances[to]
transfer uses msg.sender as the debited balance owner
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance
approve writes the allowance into allowed[msg.sender][spender] with no double-spend protection
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner
transferFrom debits balances[from] and credits balances[to]
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender]
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is consumed
transferFrom calls safeSub for the balance and allowance debits
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance
allowance returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender]
approveAndCall writes the allowance into allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call
approveAndCall uses msg.sender as the allowance owner and forwards it to receiveApproval
approveAndCall performs an external call into an attacker-controlled spender contract via receiveApproval
The arbitrary spender contract called by receiveApproval can re-enter ZIMBOCOIN / approveAndCall before the caller finishes
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call on an arbitrary token contract address
The arbitrary token contract invoked by transferAnyERC20Token can call back into the privileged function before completion
transferAnyERC20Token passes the owner state variable as the recipient of the external transfer
The external token transfer uses owner as the destination argument
